rules.semantic: A walker in its post-thaw immunity window (negative raw freeze timer, written only by the player-side drain statistics::player_thaw_tick, src/gameplay/sim_input_handler.cpp:561) counts as NOT frozen for every reader: it can act and move, the HUD/snapshot/replay show 0, and every legacy freeze guard sees the classic value. The immunity itself is read through frozen_delay_raw (living.cpp:131 climbs it +1/tick back to 0; transfer_stats copies the raw value so immunity follows the body, walker.cpp:1809).

arms.observable: frozen_delay() == raw value; a positive value freezes the walker (no move on input / AI tick)
frozen_delay() == 0 while frozen_delay_raw() < 0; walker moves on input that tick; snapshot EntitySnapshot frozen field == 0

tests.note: >=0: frozen_delay()==raw==7; <0: frozen_delay()==0 while raw==-5, and through the 12-tick climb
>=0: tick 1 frozen swallows input, shifter_down 0; <0: raw == -12 after the thaw, input reaches the movement branch on tick 3

other.note: Bounds guards on special_cost[] index (getter returns 0, setter ignores) for out-of-range slot indices from Lua/snapshot; no game semantic. Asserted by tests/integration/test_stats_unit.cpp: TEST(StatsUnit, special_cost_out_of_range_is_safe).
